Compares the old WDI internal-water denominator with WDI/AQUASTAT available-water stress, parses FAOSTAT Area harvested rows into a national crop-mix ledger, and keeps basin allocation, crop-specific water requirements, irrigation command areas, GRACE depletion, and subnational rural exposure uncomputed.

invisible_urbanization_source_readiness_.name: Public GHSL/SMOD/boundary source-readiness metadata for the invisible urbanization tautology audit

invisible_urbanization_source_readiness_.notes: Source-readiness audit for /showcase/invisible-urban-tautology. Confirms public metadata visibility for WDI urban definitions, GHSL built-up surface, GHSL SMOD, and top-five ADM2 boundaries while keeping GHSL raster export, boundary intersection, classification-history ledger, and population-weighted zonal statistic uncomputed.

port_hinterland_source_readiness_public_.name: Public logistics, port-throughput, and freight-proxy source-readiness metadata for the port-hinterland inert-parameter audit
port_hinterland_source_readiness_public_.cache_policy: Raw WDI indicator metadata JSON and country indicator JSON responses are cached under port-hinterland-friction/.cache/port-source-readiness/ and regenerated by the script; cache contents are not committed.
port_hinterland_source_readiness_public_.notes: Source-readiness audit for /showcase/port-inert-parameter. Confirms public metadata and value visibility for LPI components, imports, container port traffic, and road/rail/air freight proxies while keeping port-level dwell time, turnaround time, berth productivity, port-call delay, OD network, route impedance, corridor travel time, customs release time, trucking cost, and inland-terminal performance joins uncomputed.

school_heat_source_readiness_public_meta.name: Public WDI, CCKP, OSM, and UNICEF source-readiness metadata for the school-heat source wall
school_heat_source_readiness_public_meta.cache_policy: Raw WDI JSON, CCKP JSON, Overpass JSON, and UNICEF PDF responses are cached under school-heat-disruption/.cache/school-source-readiness/ and regenerated by the script; cache contents are not committed.
school_heat_source_readiness_public_meta.notes: Source-readiness audit for /showcase/school-heat-sensitivity. Preserves the Cambodia top-one sensitivity narrowing, checks WDI and CCKP source visibility, records OSM school-count visibility for Cambodia and Pakistan, and keeps school calendars, daily school-day heat or WBGT, school-location overlays, enrollment-weighted exposure, and closure/attendance/learning outcomes uncomputed.
